title: System Design Playbooks
description: Structured system design prompts with interviewer playbooks, deep-dive angles, and JD tailoring hooks.

questions.title: Streaming AI Assistant & Multi-Turn Workspace
questions.prompt: Design a consumer and enterprise web workspace for a streaming AI assistant (like Claude.ai) that supports long-running tool calls, artifact previews, multi-device sync, and conversation branching.

core_requirements: Low-latency token streaming (SSE/WebSocket) with graceful reconnect and partial-response resumption
Conversation tree / branching history stored cleanly across devices
Safe sandboxed rendering of generated artifacts & concurrent tool invocations
Per-tenant rate limits, quota accounting, and zero-data-retention enterprise tiers
deep_dives: Client reconnect mid-stream: how do you resume from token offset N without duplicating or losing tokens?
Backpressure & fan-out when the same conversation is open in two tabs or shared in an org
Context assembly latency when attaching large files, MCP connectors, and organizational memory

level_extensions.L4: Clean end-to-end client/API/DB flow, SSE streaming lifecycle, basic auth and pagination.
level_extensions.L5: Resumable stream buffers (e.g. Redis Streams), idempotent message writes, sandbox isolation, latency budgets.
level_extensions.L6: Multi-region inference routing, KV-cache affinity, enterprise compliance isolation (FedRAMP/ZDR), graceful degradation.

questions.title: Real-Time Collaborative Document & Commenting Studio
questions.prompt: Design a real-time collaborative editor (like Notion or Google Docs) supporting live cursors, offline edits that sync on reconnect, inline comments, and version history.

core_requirements: Sub-100ms local typing feel with optimistic UI updates
Conflict resolution across concurrent editors (CRDT vs. OT trade-offs)
Presence indicators (cursors/selections) separated from durable document mutations
Snapshotting & compaction so opening a 2-year-old doc is fast
deep_dives: CRDT (Yjs/Automerge) vs. central OT server: memory overhead, undo semantics, and schema migrations
Sticky WebSocket routing to document rooms & clean failover when a room host dies
Anchoring inline comments when surrounding text is edited or deleted

level_extensions.L4: Clear WebSocket room model, persistence of ops + periodic snapshots, simple presence.
level_extensions.L5: CRDT vs OT trade-off mastery, offline merge recovery, permission revocation mid-session.
level_extensions.L6: Cross-region active-active docs, huge document sharding, enterprise audit logs & e-discovery.

questions.title: Enterprise Connector & Plugin Execution Platform
questions.prompt: Design an extensibility platform that lets enterprise admins install third-party plugins and MCP connectors, grant fine-grained per-user OAuth permissions, and safely execute external tool calls during live workflows.

core_requirements: Connector registry, versioning, and admin approval workflows
Per-user delegated OAuth token vault with refresh and revocation
Sandboxed execution / egress policies, timeouts, retries, and circuit breakers for flaky third-party APIs
Full audit trail and observability dashboard for enterprise admins
deep_dives: Preventing confused-deputy / SSRF / prompt-injection-triggered data exfiltration across connectors
Handling slow or stalled external tools without exhausting worker pools
Token refresh storms and least-privilege scope scoping per workspace/team

level_extensions.L4: Registry CRUD, OAuth token storage, async tool invocation with timeouts.
level_extensions.L5: Security boundaries, circuit breaking, idempotency, admin RBAC & audit logging.
level_extensions.L6: Zero-trust tenant isolation, customer-managed encryption keys, multi-cloud private link egress.

questions.title: Multi-Tenant Identity, Permissions & Admin Analytics
questions.prompt: Design an enterprise authorization and admin observability system (similar to Google Zanzibar / Fine-Grained RBAC + Usage Analytics) serving multiple products across an organization.

core_requirements: Low-latency permission checks (<10ms p99) across orgs, workspaces, groups, and individual resources
SSO/SCIM provisioning and near-immediate access revocation
Real-time + historical admin analytics (seat utilization, token spend, audit export)
Consistent policy enforcement across web app, API, and CLI surfaces
deep_dives: Cache invalidation vs. staleness bounds when a user is removed from a sensitive group
Avoiding N+1 permission checks on list/search endpoints
Separating transactional auth writes from OLAP analytics pipelines

level_extensions.L4: Clean relational RBAC schema, JWT/session strategy, basic event ingestion for analytics.
level_extensions.L5: Graph/ReBAC modeling, cache consistency (zookies/version tokens), list filtering at scale.
level_extensions.L6: Cross-product policy federation, strict compliance/SOC2/FedRAMP auditability, zero-downtime policy rollouts.

questions.title: Distributed API Gateway, Rate Limiter & Token Quota System
questions.prompt: Design a globally distributed API gateway and rate-limiting service for a high-throughput developer API that enforces both requests-per-minute and streaming token-per-minute quotas.

core_requirements: Sub-5ms gateway overhead on the hot path
Support both pre-flight RPM limits and post-response token/cost accounting
Accurate burst handling without race conditions across concurrent workers
Graceful fail-open/fail-closed behavior if the rate-limit store degrades
deep_dives: Token bucket / sliding window atomic updates in Redis Lua vs. local leaky-bucket leasing
Handling streaming responses where final token count isn't known until stream completion
Multi-region quota synchronization and noisy-neighbor isolation

level_extensions.L4: Single-region Redis token bucket, clear HTTP 429 headers and retry semantics.
level_extensions.L5: Local quota leases to cut Redis RTT, reserve-then-reconcile for streaming tokens, failover policy.
level_extensions.L6: Global hierarchical quotas (org -> workspace -> key), hot-key sharding, billing ledger reconciliation.

questions.title: Permission-Aware Enterprise Knowledge Search & Memory
questions.prompt: Design an enterprise retrieval layer that indexes documents from Slack, Drive, GitHub, and Notion, stays fresh within minutes, and strictly respects each user's source permissions at query time.

core_requirements: Incremental connector ingestion (webhooks + polling fallback) and chunking pipeline
Hybrid retrieval (lexical BM25 + dense embeddings + reranking)
Strict ACL enforcement so users never see snippets from docs they lost access to
Citation provenance linking retrieved snippets back to exact source versions
deep_dives: Pre-filtering vs. post-filtering ACLs in vector search (and what breaks with large group memberships)
Handling deletions and permission revocations within strict SLAs
Evaluating retrieval quality offline and online (recall@k, latency vs. accuracy)

level_extensions.L4: Ingestion queue, chunker/embedder workers, vector + keyword search with basic ACL check.
level_extensions.L5: ACL sync & pre-filter indexing, incremental re-indexing, hybrid score fusion, freshness SLAs.
level_extensions.L6: Multi-tenant index isolation, per-tenant encryption, staleness bounds, continuous eval feedback loop.

questions.title: Developer Observability, Trace Explorer & Prompt Evals UI
questions.prompt: Design a developer observability console that ingests high-volume request/agent traces, renders interactive waterfall timelines in the browser, and lets teams run side-by-side evaluations.

core_requirements: High-throughput async ingestion API that never slows down customer production traffic
Fast faceted search & waterfall visualization over nested multi-step traces
PII scrubbing and configurable retention policies
Dataset curation + batch evaluation runner with diff UI
deep_dives: Storage layout (ClickHouse/columnar + object storage for large payloads) and hot/cold tiering
Virtualizing massive trace trees and streaming live logs in a React frontend
Tail-based sampling vs. full capture for error traces

level_extensions.L4: Buffered ingestion -> queue -> columnar store, clean React waterfall UI with pagination.
level_extensions.L5: Payload offloading to blob store, tail sampling, virtualized UI performance, eval job orchestration.
level_extensions.L6: Multi-tenant ingestion isolation, cost-controlled retention, real-time anomaly alerting.

questions.title: Real-Time Notification & Activity Feed System
questions.prompt: Design a multi-channel notification and activity feed system (in-app, email, push, Slack) with user preferences, deduplication, digest batching, and read-state sync across devices.

core_requirements: Fan-out delivery across multiple channels with per-user quiet hours and preferences
Idempotent event ingestion and smart collapsing ('Alex and 4 others commented')
Real-time badge count and read-state sync across mobile + web
Delivery tracking, retries with exponential backoff, and dead-letter handling
deep_dives: Fan-out-on-write vs. fan-out-on-read for high-follower or org-wide broadcasts
Exactly-once user perception via idempotency keys & deduplication windows
Scheduling delayed digests cleanly without thundering herds at 9:00 AM

level_extensions.L4: Event queue, preference lookup, channel workers, cursor-paginated feed API.
level_extensions.L5: Hybrid fan-out, grouping/collapsing pipeline, provider fallback & backpressure.
level_extensions.L6: Global priority lanes (OTP vs marketing), delivery SLOs, multi-region active-active read state.

questions.title: Feature Flagging & Live A/B Experimentation Platform
questions.prompt: Design a feature-flag and live experimentation platform used by web, mobile, and backend services to safely ramp launches, run A/B tests, and auto-rollback regressions.

core_requirements: Zero-network-hop (<1ms) local flag evaluation in SDKs with deterministic bucketing
Instant global propagation (<5s) for emergency kill switches
Exposure logging joined cleanly with product/revenue metrics without sample ratio mismatch
Mutual exclusion groups and guardrails for automated rollback
deep_dives: Consistent hashing (user_id + experiment_salt) so changing rollout % doesn't flip existing users
Preventing flicker on SSR/React hydration when assigning client-side experiments
Streaming rule-config updates via SSE/CDN edge caches at millions of connected clients

level_extensions.L4: Rule schema, deterministic hash bucketing, CDN-cached SDK config + exposure events.
level_extensions.L5: SSE/delta sync, SSR hydration consistency, SRM detection, staged rollout guardrails.
level_extensions.L6: Cross-layer experiment isolation, sequential testing stats pipeline, enterprise RBAC on kill switches.

questions.title: Durable Long-Running Agent & Background Workflow Engine
questions.prompt: Design a durable workflow execution engine that runs multi-step background jobs (including human-in-the-loop approvals and external API calls) that can pause for hours and resume cleanly after crashes.

core_requirements: Step-level checkpointing so completed side effects aren't re-executed on crash recovery
Pause/resume for human approvals, timers, and webhook callbacks
Per-tenant concurrency limits and fair scheduling across noisy tenants
Live status streaming and cancellation propagation into running steps
deep_dives: State-machine / event-sourced log vs. relational workflow table with lease locking
Handling zombie workers via heartbeats, fencing tokens, and idempotency keys
Fair queuing across tenants when one customer submits 100k workflows

level_extensions.L4: DB-backed job state machine, worker polling with visibility timeouts, retries.
level_extensions.L5: Checkpointed step ledger, fencing tokens, tenant fair queuing, live progress UI.
level_extensions.L6: Workflow code versioning for in-flight runs, multi-region failover, deterministic replay.
